title: Soft Reset
tagline: Tidy a tiny digital room until it feels like morning.
description: A desktop is cluttered with half-finished notes, blinking reminders, and a sleeping cursor. Sort the windows, archive the noise, and make one corner quiet.
prompt: Build a self-contained browser game called Soft Reset. A desktop is cluttered with half-finished notes, blinking reminders, and a sleeping cursor. Sort the windows, archive the noise, and make one corner quiet.
